categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Haishun specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of pharmaceutical packaging materials, focusing on high-performance packaging for pharmaceuticals, new energy, and new consumer sectors. Its product portfolio includes soft packaging materials like cold-formed composite sheets, PTP aluminum foil, and composite films, as well as hard packaging materials such as PVC-based sheets, plastic bottles, and precision injection molded components. The company also extends into new energy materials, particularly aluminum-plastic films for lithium batteries, and new consumer packaging solutions for electronics and food.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs core technologies including composite cold forming, multilayer co-extrusion, precision coating, and precision injection molding. It has developed proprietary adhesive technologies for dry and hot processes in aluminum-plastic film production. The manufacturing process is digitally controlled via ERP systems with barcode management to ensure material balance and prevent product confusion. The company also emphasizes R&D in recyclable composite materials, functional membrane materials, and high-barrier packaging films, supported by a strong patent portfolio and industry standard participation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international pharmaceutical companies such as Qilu Pharmaceutical, Yunnan Baiyao, Shanghai Pharmaceuticals, Guangzhou Pharmaceutical, Huahai Pharmaceutical, Federal Pharmaceutical, and AstraZeneca. The products serve various pharmaceutical dosage forms including tablets, capsules, granules, powders, and suppositories. The company also targets new energy sectors like 3C digital batteries and power storage polymer batteries, as well as new consumer markets including food packaging and electronic cigarettes.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Shanghai and multiple subsidiaries across Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Hebei, and other provinces. It has established an international presence through its wholly-owned subsidiary Haishun Europe GmbH in Berlin and actively participates in global pharmaceutical packaging exhibitions in countries such as South Korea, Japan, Italy, and Egypt. Its overseas customers span Southeast Asia, the Americas, Europe, and the Middle East, with growing penetration into emerging and developed markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Haishun operates mainly in the midstream segment of the pharmaceutical packaging supply chain, manufacturing high-barrier packaging materials and components. It procures raw materials such as aluminum foil, adhesives, PVC, nylon, PE, PET, and inks from upstream suppliers and supplies finished packaging products directly to pharmaceutical manufacturers and downstream customers. The company also engages in some upstream activities by developing base film materials for packaging enterprises.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation with sustained R&D investment focused on recyclable composite materials, functional membranes, aluminum-plastic films, and new packaging solutions like anti-counterfeit cold-formed aluminum composite sheets and high-barrier liquid packaging films. It emphasizes green development by advancing recyclable and degradable materials and carbon footprint visualization platforms. Strategic R&D collaborations with universities and participation in industry standard setting are key. The company also focuses on digitalization, intelligent manufacturing, and expanding international markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of pharmaceutical packaging materials and related products. The company employs a 'make-to-order' production model based on customer contracts and orders. Sales are conducted mainly via direct sales to pharmaceutical companies domestically and internationally, supplemented by a buyout distribution model for trade customers. The company also earns investment income from equity holdings and financial asset management.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai Haishun is positioned as a leading domestic pharmaceutical packaging materials provider with a strong brand and technical edge. It competes in a fragmented industry with many small and medium enterprises, focusing on high-end, high-barrier packaging solutions to differentiate itself. The company has established partnerships with top pharmaceutical firms and is expanding its global footprint, aiming to strengthen its market share against both domestic and international competitors by leveraging innovation and quality.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.14 billion, representing an 11.92% increase over the previous year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 74.6 million, a decrease of 12.7% year-over-year. The company’s total assets stood at RMB 2.89 billion with net assets of RMB 1.74 billion. It has shown steady revenue growth and increased cash flow from operations, while investing heavily in capacity expansion and R&D to sustain long-term growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Haishun emphasizes high-performance, safe, and innovative pharmaceutical packaging solutions that ensure drug quality and patient safety. Its products feature advanced barrier properties, anti-counterfeiting technologies, and environmentally friendly materials aligned with global green packaging trends. The company offers comprehensive packaging services covering the entire pharmaceutical supply chain, backed by rigorous quality control and compliance with international standards, providing customers with reliable, customized, and sustainable packaging solutions.
